# Source

`Source` is an object type. You don't create it directly: you get one from another call, then call its methods with a colon, e.g. `source:name()`.

## Obtained from

- [`system.getSource()`](../../system/getSource.md)
- [`LogicSwitch:activeCondition()`](../../objects/LogicSwitch/activeCondition.md)
- [`LogicSwitch:values()`](../../objects/LogicSwitch/values.md)
- [`Timer:startCondition()`](../../objects/Timer/startCondition.md)
- [`Timer:stopCondition()`](../../objects/Timer/stopCondition.md)
- [`Timer:countingSource()`](../../objects/Timer/countingSource.md)
- [`Timer:resetCondition()`](../../objects/Timer/resetCondition.md)
